edge.title: PowerCool LR, Contra→Muon→Soft-Muon ramp, attention SOAP moved to V
edge.summary: Three groups of changes on #16's stack. (1) The linear cooldown is replaced by PowerCool, lr = min(lr0, c·(3105 − step)^1.2) with hand-set per-group c, so Muon starts decaying at ≈ step 719 and the AdamW groups at ≈ step 1692; the run stops at 3040 (claimed 3030), before the LR reaches 0. (2) The polar step becomes time-dependent: Contra-Muon's −0.2·ĝ term ramps linearly to 0 by step 2000 (plain Muon), then from step 2500 the update is blended toward Soft-Muon (a fixed combination of NS iterates approximating σ^0.1, which keeps the singular-value ordering), reaching 80% at step 2908; all norm computations switch to the Schatten-4 estimate √‖XᵀX‖_F. (3) Attention SOAP moves from trust-gated attn.proj to ungated attn.v (blend 0.95, denominator floor 0.55), and the u/w-floor target rises from 0.35 to 0.3825.

changes.label: PowerCool LR schedule
changes.detail: set_hparams uses _lr = min(initial_lr, power_c·max(0, 3105 − step)^1.2) per group (power_c: embed 4.98e-5, head 5.18e-7, 1-D 1.66e-6, Muon 3.32e-6); training stops at FINAL_TRAIN_STEPS = 3040 < FINAL_SCHEDULE_STEPS = 3105.

changes.label: Late Soft-Muon blend (p=0.1, cap 0.8)
changes.detail: soft_via_newtonschulz5 combines 12 NS iterates with fixed p = 0.1 coefficients; muon_update blends contra_update toward soft_update with weight min(0.8, (step − 2500)/510), renormalized to the NS output's Schatten-4 norm.

changes.label: Contra-Muon ramped off by step 2000
changes.detail: contra_coeff_for_step scales CONTRA_MUON_COEFF = −0.2 by (1 − step/2000): Contra-Muon at step 0, plain NS from 2000; ĝ is now normalized by the Schatten-4 estimate instead of power iteration.

changes.label: Attention SOAP: attn.proj → attn.v
changes.detail: SOAP_PARAM_MODE = 'mlp_plus_v': attn.v gets SOAP with V_SOAP_BLEND = 0.95 and denominator floor 0.55, gate fixed at 1; attn.proj is no longer preconditioned, so the trust gate never runs.

changes.label: Schatten-4 norm replaces Frobenius
changes.detail: gram_frobenius_norm_estimate (√‖XᵀX‖_F) replaces the Frobenius pre-normalization inside NS and every Frobenius norm-matching step (Contra, NorMuon-lite, SOAP output, blends).

changes.label: u/w floor 0.35 → 0.3825
changes.detail: TARGET_UW = 0.3825 for both SOAP and non-SOAP matrices (SOAP_TARGET_UW = NONSOAP_TARGET_UW).

changes.label: Steps 3175 → 3040, claim 3030
changes.detail: FINAL_TRAIN_STEPS = 3040 with schedule endpoint 3105; claimed at the 3030 checkpoint (Muon LR ≈1.6%, AdamW ≈3% of peak).

changes.label: Hooks, CLI seed, logging
changes.detail: argparse --seed, hard-coded LOG_DIR, EARLY_STOP screening and tail validation removed, disabled hooks (NO_CONTRA_PARAM / NO_SOFTMUON_PARAM empty, ATTN_SOAP_FADE_* at 1e9, V_SOAP_BLEND_RAMP_END_STEP = 0).

edge.parent_check: Code base is #16 (nearest-code #16), but #16's defining attn.proj trust-gated SOAP is inactive: SOAP_PARAM_MODE = 'mlp_plus_v' moves attention SOAP to attn.v without a gate (trust_gate/bounded_trust_gate remain as dead code). PowerCool is credited to PR287 (Yash Pande), which is not an accepted record in this table.
edge.noise: Docstring/credits, argparse seed, LOG_DIR, removal of EARLY_STOP/TARGET_VAL_LOSS screening and 2-step tail validation, new unused SOAP_PARAM_MODE options (mlp_plus_q/k/v), disabled hooks (NO_CONTRA_PARAM, NO_SOFTMUON_PARAM, ATTN_SOAP_FADE_*, V_SOAP_BLEND_RAMP_END_STEP), unused SOFT_MUON_SCALE branches, config prints.

techniques.note: Nesterov mu=0.95, 12 NS iters with Schatten-4 (√‖XXᵀ‖_F) input normalization, lr 0.0375
+coeff·M/‖M‖_S4 with coeff −0.2 at step 0 → 0 linearly by step 2000; norm restored
p=0.1 map from weighted NS iterates; blend 0 → 0.8 over steps 2500–2908, held at 0.8
variance EMA (β2 0.95) along the longer dim; norm restoration now Schatten-4 based
target 0.3825 for all hidden matrices; wd 0.025 passed but never applied
mlp.fc/mlp.proj, β 0.90, basis refresh every 10, blend 1.0 (unchanged)
attn.v only: 0.95·SOAP + 0.05·raw momentum, denom floor 0.55×RMS, no trust gate
lr = min(lr0, c·(3105 − step)^1.2) per group; stop at 3040 with LR ≈1.35% (Muon) of peak
implicit via per-group c: Muon decays from ≈ step 719, AdamW groups from ≈ step 1692
AdamW lr embed 0.3 / head 1/320 / 1-D 0.01, betas (0.8, 0.95), eps 1e-10, wd 0

hparams.hidden.optimizer: Muon (Contra→NS→Soft blend) + SOAP (MLP, attn.v) + NorMuon-lite + u/w floor
hparams.soft_muon.ramp: linear from step 2500 to 3010 (cap reached at 2908)

mechanisms.name: Soft-Muon
mechanisms.explain: soft_via_newtonschulz5 normalizes the input by its Schatten-4 norm, runs the same 12 NS iterations as Muon, and returns a fixed linear combination of the iterates X0…X11 (coefficients for p = 0.1, summing to 1). The resulting singular-value map approximates σ^0.1 (e.g. 0.1 → 0.79, 0.5 → 0.93), so stronger directions still get larger steps instead of being flattened to 1. In muon_update it is rescaled to the NS output's norm and mixed in with weight min(0.8, (step − 2500)/510), after Contra-Muon has ramped to zero by step 2000; the mix then goes through NorMuon-lite and the u/w floor.

mechanisms.name: PowerCool LR schedule
mechanisms.explain: Each group's LR is min(initial_lr, c·(t_end − step)^1.2) with t_end = FINAL_SCHEDULE_STEPS = 3105 and hard-coded per-group c: flat until the power-law curve drops below the peak, then a slightly convex power-law decay toward t_end. Training stops at 3040, before t_end, so the LR never reaches 0 (≈1.35% of peak for Muon and ≈2.5% for AdamW at the last step).

mechanisms.name: Split cooldown via PowerCool constants
mechanisms.explain: The per-group constants put the onset of decay at ≈ step 719 for Muon (a ≈2386-step, ≈77% cooldown) but ≈ step 1692 for all three AdamW groups (≈1413 steps, ≈45%). Hidden matrices therefore anneal much longer than the embeddings, head and gains, the same idea as #24's 0.8/0.4 split, here encoded in power_c rather than cooldown_frac.

caveats: V_SOAP_BLEND = 0.95 mixes the whitened direction with the raw momentum before norm matching, so the effective 95/5 split depends on their unnormalized magnitudes. The switch to Schatten-4 norms (which also makes Contra's ĝ have spectral norm ≤ 1 rather than ≈ 1) is not mentioned in the README or table. The benchmark README attributes the 0.3825 u/w target to the #29/#30 lineage, but it is already set here. Soft-Muon is computed every step even while its blend weight is 0. Effective Muon wd 0 (FINAL_MUON_WD = 0.025 unused).
